relationships.subject: TF/PS/TDP-43-IN-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Pre-treatment with TDP-43-in, TDP-43-IN-1, and TF/PS/TDP-43-IN-1 significantly reduced the expression of IL-6 and TNF-α mRNA in the ipsilateral spinal cord dorsal horn

relationships.subject: TF/PS/TDP-43-IN-1
relationships.evidence_quote: reduced inflammatory cytokine expression, and suppression of the cGAS-STING pathway

key_findings: TF/PS liposomes carrying a TDP-43 inhibitor cross the BBB, target glia, and relieve CCI pain in male mice.
Treatment reduced spinal IL-6/TNF-α and shifted glia toward protective phenotypes.
